note: REPORT ONLY. None of these instruments can pass or fail a release.

catalogue_hide_and_recover.ci: Wilson 95% computed per file in registry/build_report_*.json
catalogue_hide_and_recover.caveat: Structurally blind to this axis: every added dot is >=3 px from every catalogue pixel by construction, so the proxy can only register the removal half of a RELIEF move. Deltas here are an artefact and were NOT used to set a predicted sign (IRREGULARITIES.md item 7).

surrogate_dti_catalogue_as_truth.caveat: The catalogue is masked pixel-exactly in live scoring, so this is a counterfactual coverage measure, not a score estimate.

leakage_canary: see registry/leakage_canary.json - PASS, max single-feature AUC 0.562 (threshold 0.90)

sgmc_control.reason: The SGMC control raster (ext_derived_sgmc_faults_100m_u8, sha256 643cbe99...) was not restored this session. It is report-only and cannot gate a file, so it was deferred rather than fetched; restore it via registry/data_manifest.json if the human wants the control.
sgmc_control.impact_on_decisions: none - no variant depends on it

block_density_cv.definition: 1 km x 1 km blocks (10 x 10 px), density = dots / footprint px per block, blocks with >=50% footprint
block_density_cv.caveat: Not comparable to the 0.51-0.59 figure quoted in the brief nor to the 0.62-0.76 reported upstream; at ~0.73 dots per block Poisson noise alone gives ~1.2. Reported, never used as a target (IRREGULARITIES.md item 6).
